unresolved_items.summary: Resolve the PRD `plan:` backlink handoff before freezing this focused S1 plan.
unresolved_items.answer: Default path: keep the PRD `plan:` pointer on the umbrella plan while this slice is still a draft, then run `frontmatter_link_sync.py` during `phase_freeze` or `freeze_all confirm=true` to repoint the backlink to this slice plan once S1 becomes the active frozen plan. Only fall back to a readiness-rule change if that handoff would violate umbrella governance. Use P0-T3 to dry-run the sync and keep this blocker open until the handoff path is verified.
